name: James Cook University Singapore
summary: Singapore campus of an Australian university: two-year degrees in business, commerce, psychology and IT, with January, May and September intakes.

ib.text: Asks for 12 years of schooling and English at IELTS 6.0; no IB score or subject is published. Ask the admissions office which IB result it accepts for your course.

noDeadline: Rolling; cut-off is 6 weeks before each trimester starts

notes: Degrees are the Australian university’s own, taught in Singapore over 24 months full-time (4 subjects a trimester, three trimesters a year).
Application fee is S$260 (non-refundable); you need a Student’s Pass, and Student Pass holders may not work without a work permit.
Bachelor of Psychological Science (Honours) is a 12-month add-on after a bachelor’s degree, not a first degree, so it is not listed.
